text:
incident-bot: PAGER: GPU capacity alert (primary-east-1). Queue length on primary-gpu-pool > 1200 reqs, token latency p95 > 4.2s, autoscaler failing to add nodes (scale_error=quota_limit). Severity: high. Please ack and follow incident runbook.

alice_oncall: acked. I'm oncall for the hour. grabbing metrics now.

bob_sre: looking at autoscaler logs — we see repeated errors: 
```
E 11:02:12 autoscaler.go:312 provision failed: insufficient quota in region: GPU_QUOTA_EXCEEDED
E 11:02:12 provisioner provider-aws: rate limit for create-instances
```
Queue growth started ~11:00 UTC. Autoscaler attempted 3 times and hit soft quota.

carla_eng: confirming model pools: primary-east-1 is running v2.4-highmem instances, all pools already at max reserved count. There was a config change yesterday that lowered fallback threshold from 0.9->0.8 (we pushed a tighter SLO), might be causing more spill to primary.

alice_oncall: what's customer impact? dave_support, do you have any alerts?

dave_support: yes — support is seeing a spike in rate-limited customers and a couple reports of 429s and elevated latencies. Top affected tenants: acme-marketing, docuqa-enterprise (both pinned to primary region). I've opened a ticket with a short summary and which API keys impacted.

frank_prod: urgent — a paying Dedicated customer is affected, they're seeing sustained request backlog. Can we fast-route their traffic?

erin_network: routing checks: cross-region steering is enabled but policy currently prefers primary-east-1 for low-latency. We can flip a steer to prefer eu-west-1 and apac1 as fallback, but need to ensure model variant compatibility. eu-west-1 has compatible quantized variant 2.3-q which is slightly lower perf but available.

alice_oncall: plan: (1) temporarily enable cross-region redirect for non-pinned tenants, (2) throttle non-critical routes, (3) try a manual reserved node increase request to infra-provider console, (4) remove the recent fallback-tightening change if it worsened spill. Any objections?

bob_sre: +1. I'll attempt manual provision for 8 gpus in primary-east-1 (small capacity boost). If provider refuses due to quota, I will request a quota raise but that takes time.

carla_eng: I'll rollback the fallback threshold change to previous value (0.9) to let more traffic use cheaper variants in other regions. Pushing a small config change to routing-service now.

deploy-bot: CI/CD: deploy started by carla_eng on routing-service (change-id: rout-2026-033).

monitoring-bot: Alert suppression: will suppress repeated autoscaler errors for next 30m to reduce noise.

alice_oncall: erin, can you flip steering for the following route groups: public-gen, embeddings-batch? Keep dedicated customers pinned.

erin_network: doing it now. Command: 
```
api route update --group public-gen --prefer eu-west-1,apac1 --allow-fallback true
```
Response: OK queued. Changes live in ~45s.

(45s later)
erin_network: steering change live. Initial telemetry shows 18% of new traffic now landing in eu-west-1.

bob_sre: manual provision attempt: provider returned 403 quota. I have an open support case with provider; ETA unknown. Trying to provision smaller instance types as stopgap.

carla_eng: rollback complete. Routing fallback threshold restored to 0.9. This should let more requests match quantized variants in secondary regions.

alice_oncall: support, ask impacted customers if they can tolerate eu-west-1 or apac routing for now. frank_prod, coordinate with sales for the dedicated pinned tenant.

dave_support: reaching out to top 5 impacted customers now. Update: acme-marketing accepts routing to eu-west-1 for short window. docuqa-enterprise is asking for SLA note, escalating to frank_prod.

frank_prod: on it. I'll offer a credit and explain mitigation steps.

(10m later)

bob_sre: good news — queue growth stabilized after steering change + rollback. p95 latency dropped to 2.1s overall. However primary-east-1 still at 92% GPU utilization and queue ~480. Autoscaler continues to error on quota if it tries to add nodes.

alice_oncall: partial success. We need a durable fix: (A) provider quota increase (long term), (B) decrease default region affinity for non-enterprise tenants (policy), (C) improve autoscaler fallback to alternate providers. Create tickets.

carla_eng: I've scheduled a follow-up for autoscaler to broaden fallback to more model variants and to attempt multi-region simultaneous provisioning. Creating PRs for both.

erin_network: note: we saw a transient misroute for one dedicated customer that was pinned — debugging pin-check path. No customer traffic lost, but misroute caused extra validation errors; patch in progress.

monitoring-bot: incident-bot: Customer-impact severity updated to "partial degradation".

alice_oncall: summary for now: steering change + fallback threshold rollback prevented outage escalation. Manual provision failed due to provider quota; autoscaler still needs more robust provider quota handling. Customers mostly stable; two enterprise tenants impacted and engaged. We're keeping this incident open for follow-up and will rotate off after stabilization.

bob_sre: ACTION: created infra ticket INFRA-4821 to request quota bump and add multi-region fallback to autoscaler.

carla_eng: ACTION: PR 4578 to routing-service to reduce region affinity and PR 4579 to autoscaler heuristics.

frank_prod: ACTION: Sales ticket SALES-2189 for credits to docuqa-enterprise and ACME.

alice_oncall: I'll stay on for 30 more minutes watching for regressions. If p95 stays <3s and queue <600 for 20m, I'll close.

(18m later)
alice_oncall: p95 = 1.8s, queue = 320, no new 429s. Closing monitoring window soon.

dave_support: customers confirmed improved experience. Marking support tickets RESOLVED-WAIT-30D for follow-up.

alice_oncall: closing this thread in 10. Postmortem owners assigned: bob_sre (autoscaler), carla_eng (routing), erin_network (pinning logic). Notify infra-provider quota request in INFRA-4821.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: primary-east-1 GPU saturation mitigated via cross-region steering + routing rollback. Duration: ~52 minutes. Follow-up tasks created.

alice_oncall: thanks team. Postmortem notes: avoid last-minute fallback-tightening changes before peak traffic periods; ensure provider quota check is part of canary. Adding to runbook: verify provider quota before autoscaler ramp. :thumbsup:
